# graphiant_device_bringup (Resource)

Triggers a bulk device bringup/activation status transition (V1DevicesBringupPut). This is action-shaped, not a persistent object: there is no "un-bringup" endpoint, so Delete only removes the resource from Terraform state — it does not change the devices' actual status on the server. The API does not document valid status values; pass through whatever string your deployment uses.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Action-shaped: triggers a bulk bringup status transition. There is no
# "un-bringup" endpoint, so `terraform destroy` only removes this from state.
resource "graphiant_device_bringup" "activate" {
  device_ids = [12345, 12346]
  status     = "activate"
}
```

### Required

- `device_ids` (List of Number)
- `status` (String)

### Read-Only

- `devices` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--devices))
- `id` (String) Derived from the sorted device_ids; not a server-assigned identifier.
